en.bdb: Duties of the yugs --the Time periods

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਫੜਿ ਦੇਸੁ ਪੀੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satijug ik vigaaRadhaa tis pichhai faR dhes peeRaae|

en.bdb: In the Satyug the whole country suffered because of the evil deeds of one wrong-doer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਵਗਲੀਐ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਹਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: tretai nagaree vagaleeaai dhuaapar va(n)s narak sahamaae|

en.bdb: In Tretia the whole city was surrounded and in Dvapar, the whole family was to suffer hell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਫੇੜੈ ਸੋ ਫੜੀਦਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jo feRai so faReedhaa kalijug sachaa niaau karaae|

en.bdb: The justice of Kaliyug is true because only he suffers who does the evil deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਜੁਗਾ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satijug sat tretai jugaa dhuaapar poojaa chaar dhiRaae|

en.bdb: In Satyug, the truth, in Treta- the yajti, in Dvapar ritualistic worship were accomplished.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਹੋਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug naau araadhanaa hor karam kar mukat na paae|

en.bdb: In Kaliyug through no action other than constant remembering the Lord's name could attain liberation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਲੁਣੀਐ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jug jug luneeaai beejiaa paap pu(n)n kar dhukh sukh paae|

en.bdb: In all the yugs (ages) the individual reaps what he has sown and earns sufferings and delights in accordance with his demer

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਪਹੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug chitavai pu(n)n fal paapahu lep adharam kamaae|

en.bdb: In Kaliyug, the individual desires to have the fruits of meritorious actions though he remains absorbed in the sinful deeds
Gurmukhs attain the pleasure fruit only by losing their sense of ego
